newsitem.title: UK: British Gas indicated lower after Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: British Gas indicated lower after Q3 loss.

text.p: Shares in British Gas were indicated lower in pre-market trading on Thursday after the company reported that its historic net loss widened to a larger-than-expected 364 million in the third quarter.
At 0805 GMT, the shares, under pressure in recent sessions after Shell Transport ruled out a bid for the company, were down 1-1/2p to 219-1/2p.
After exceptional charges of 304 million stg, British Gas said its losses widened to 364 million stg, which was greater than analysts' forecasts for losses of 150 million to 128 million stg.
But analyst Nigel Hawkins of Yamaichi said share losses should be limited as the market is still focused on the fate of the group's Transco unit.
"British Gas will live and die by that until the saga is over," said Hawkins, referring to the MMC referral.
A marketmaker added, "I don't think these results are material at all. There are a lot more important things going on with British Gas."
